components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Square, green conversion action used in the hero and primary narrative flow.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:50px; padding:.78rem 1.25rem; color:var(--paper-bright, #fbfaf5); background:var(--green, #23745f); text-decoration:none; font:750 .84rem/1.4 "Work Sans", sans-serif; border-radius:0; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-primary-action:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); background:var(--green, #23745f); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ink, #111915); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-primary-action:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Header Action
components.description: Compact pill conversion action reserved for the sticky header.
components.css: .ds-header-action { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:50px; padding:.78rem 1.25rem; color:var(--paper-bright, #fbfaf5); background:var(--ink, #111915); text-decoration:none; font:750 .84rem/1.4 "Work Sans", sans-serif; border-radius:999px; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-header-action:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); background:var(--green, #23745f); } .ds-header-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ink, #111915); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-header-action:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Sport Chip
components.description: Pill choice whose selected state carries the synchronized sport accent.
components.css: .ds-sport-row { display:flex; gap:8px; } .ds-sport-chip { min-height:42px; padding:.65rem .9rem; color:var(--ink, #111915); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--line, rgba(17,25,21,.2)); border-radius:999px; font:650 .76rem/1.4 "Work Sans", sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-sport-chip:hover { border-color:var(--ink, #111915); } .ds-sport-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { color:var(--ink, #111915); background:var(--sport-accent, #39c79d); border-color:var(--ink, #111915); } .ds-sport-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ink, #111915); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Quiet desktop navigation link with a directional editorial underline.
components.html: Inside the app
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; justify-content:center; } .ds-nav-link { position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; color:var(--ink-soft, #536059); text-decoration:none; font:650 .82rem/1.4 "Work Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link::after { content:""; position:absolute; right:0; bottom:7px; left:0; height:1px; background:var(--ink, #111915); transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:right; transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color:var(--ink, #111915); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after { transform:scaleX(1); transform-origin:left; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ink, #111915); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: FAQ Disclosure
components.description: Ruled question row with a rotating plus instead of card chrome.
components.html:
Is DoThis only for one sport?

No. Choose the sport state that fits how you train.
components.css: .ds-faq { color:var(--ink, #111915); border-top:1px solid var(--ink, #111915); border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink, #111915); font-family:"Work Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-faq summary { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:88px; padding:20px 54px 20px 0; cursor:pointer; font-size:1.12rem; font-weight:700; list-style:none; } .ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; } .ds-faq summary::after { content:"+"; position:absolute; right:4px; font-size:1.7rem; font-weight:400; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-faq[open] summary::after { transform:rotate(45deg); } .ds-faq summary:hover { color:var(--green, #23745f); } .ds-faq summary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ink, #111915); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-faq p { max-width:66ch; margin:-4px 0 28px; color:var(--ink-soft, #536059); }

components.name: Evidence Board
components.description: Square Night-backed frame for approved full-height sport boards.
components.css: .ds-evidence-board { margin:0; overflow:hidden; color:var(--night-text, #f5f6f1); background:var(--night, #080d11); border-radius:0; box-shadow:0 24px 52px rgba(17,25,21,.18); } .ds-evidence-placeholder { display:grid; place-items:center; aspect-ratio:660/1434; padding:24px; color:var(--night-soft, #aab8b1); border:1px solid var(--line-dark, rgba(245,246,241,.18)); font:700 .75rem/1.4 "Work Sans", sans-serif; letter-spacing:.05em; text-align:center; } .ds-evidence-board:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--sport-accent, #39c79d); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Native Screen Frame
components.description: Rounded structural frame for real simulator captures on colored or dark fields.
components.css: .ds-native-screen { margin:0; overflow:hidden; color:var(--night-text, #f5f6f1); background:var(--night, #080d11); border-radius:16px; box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(17,25,21,.3); } .ds-native-placeholder { display:grid; place-items:center; aspect-ratio:640/1391; padding:24px; color:var(--night-soft, #aab8b1); background:var(--night-raised, #12191d); font:700 .75rem/1.4 "Work Sans", sans-serif; letter-spacing:.05em; text-align:center; } .ds-native-screen:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--sport-accent, #39c79d); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview:
DoThis is an athlete field manual: warm paper, blunt black editorial type, ruled evidence, and DoThis green give training guidance the authority of a working document rather than a generic fitness campaign. It treats the athlete's whole week as the subject and uses large approved sport boards and real simulator captures as evidence, never decoration.

The system alternates paper, green, and near-black chapters to control pacing without losing continuity. Monumental propositions create conviction; Work Sans carries explanatory detail at a calm reading density. Sport accent changes are synchronized with sport imagery, benefit copy, product proof, URL state, and App Store destination.
keyCharacteristics: Warm field-manual paper and hairline rules.
DoThis green as the durable brand signal; sport accents as state, not decoration.
Full-height approved marketing boards and readable real product screens.
Flat editorial structure with selective, heavy media depth.
One coherent sport state across content, evidence, and action.

rules.name: The State-Is-System Rule
rules.body: A sport accent never changes alone; selected chip, evidence field, imagery, benefit, URL state, and App Store destination change together.

rules.name: The Green Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Use DoThis Green for brand authority and deliberate interaction feedback, not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Archivo Black makes propositions; Work Sans explains, labels, and enables action.

rules.name: The Short-Measure Rule
rules.body: Large statements stay deliberately narrow, generally 9ch–15ch, while explanatory copy stays readable at 43ch–66ch.

rules.name: The Evidence Gets Half Rule
rules.body: On wide screens, product evidence must remain large enough to read and may not be reduced to a decorative phone thumbnail.

rules.name: The Stack Without Shrinking Rule
rules.body: Responsive layouts stack narrative and evidence before either becomes illegible.

rules.name: The Evidence-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: Persistent shadows belong to product or campaign evidence; ordinary content remains flat and separated by rules or tonal fields.

rules.name: The Pills Are Controls Rule
rules.body: Pill geometry identifies compact choices and actions; it does not turn content sections into floating cards.

dos: Do keep warm paper, Editorial Ink, DoThis Green, ruled evidence, and approved full-height boards as one coherent Field Manual world.
Do use real simulator captures and approved marketing boards at readable scale.
Do keep all sport-linked imagery, copy, product proof, accent, URL state, and App Store destination synchronized.
Do preserve 44px touch targets, visible 3px focus outlines, horizontal selector access, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use open grids, chapter fields, tonal shifts, and rules before introducing a new container.
donts: Don't use a generic fitness hero, interchangeable gym imagery, or app screenshots as tiny decorative props.
Don't fabricate, repaint, crop away, or visually modify approved app UI and marketing boards.
Don't scatter sport accent colors as ambient decoration or mix multiple sport states in one view.
Don't round every surface into a card; pills are reserved for controls, and content stays editorial.
Don't add testimonials, performance metrics, medical outcomes, install claims, or product capabilities without verified evidence.
